relationships.subject: polyneuropathy with neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: The CGRP level was significantly higher in the D-PNP and ND-PNP groups compared to the control and NNP groups (P<0.05).

relationships.subject: polyneuropathy with neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: PACAP levels were significantly higher in the D-PNP and ND-PNP groups compared to the control and NNP groups (P<0.05).

key_findings: Plasma CGRP and serum PACAP are elevated in polyneuropathy patients with neuropathic pain but do not correlate with pain scale.
